name: Rogue River (Wild & Scenic)
blurb: The classic Oregon multi-day: Grave Creek to Foster Bar through roadless canyon, with lodges along the way.

sections.notes: BLM permit lottery in the main season. Most boats line or run the fish ladder at Rainie Falls. Scout Blossom Bar — it is the serious one.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Grave Creek. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency point identifies the boat-launch approach above the seasonal gravel bar, not a fixed water edge. This is the ramp record, not the dump-station record.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Foster Bar. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

mapAuditNote: Agency source and satellite facility review completed 2026-10-29. Only sections with two documented access sites and a separate section approval are shown; approximate markers do not establish an exact landing or river path.
